semantics.defaults: On initial calls, omitted/null Source Connection key selects all scoped Objects; omitted/empty Object keys selects all scoped detail/relationship groups; omitted/empty assertion keys selects all authorized active applicable assertions. Cursor-only continuations restore their original selection.
semantics.scope: All records are preloaded and frozen. Objects and Attributes are restricted to eligible selected Objects; source evidence is restricted to their contributing registered sources. Only active, applicable authorized assertion records are loaded. Tools never change endpoint eligibility.
semantics.applied_relationships_validation: No validation_* fields or measured relationship-validation results are included in this evidence variable. Stored validation remains separate backend-owned state and is not deleted by this prompt projection. Existing confidence may be low, medium, or high; high-only generation does not filter prior evidence out.
semantics.assertion_payload: Only active applicable assertions from active authorized documents are supplied. Text and document/record keys retain their stored nominal identities. modeling_assertion_details is the stored bounded JSON object, with type-dependent keys; {} means no structured details. modeling_assertion_source_location is a stored bounded locator object or null. Their example keys are illustrative, not a new universal assertion schema. No raw document body or document metadata dump is added.
semantics.relationship_locks_and_identity: Locked and unlocked applied relationships may be referenced. Locked records cannot be overridden by generation. Within a Model, identity is complete from Attribute key plus complete to Attribute key plus normalized relationship_kind. Before persistence, automatically collapse candidate rows that share this identity and identical remaining normalized content. Conflicting content is returned for model correction; never choose arbitrarily. Resolve existing identities to existing records, treating unchanged content as a no-op. Preserve governed updates, status/lock ownership, and SQL uniqueness. Do not merge distinct legitimate kinds/directions or use equivalent renaming/reversal to evade locks.
semantics.candidate_repair: For correctable output-schema or semantic candidate errors, including conflicting duplicates and broken references, the backend sends bounded structured code/path/message feedback and the previous candidate when it fits, using the same frozen template, selected tools, authorized scope/evidence and output schema. The model returns a corrected complete candidate; backend validation reruns. This applies in both modes and uses the existing configured validation_retry_count. No invalid candidate is applied. Exhaustion fails the run; authorization, lost Tenant Lock, stale revision, infrastructure and unexpected validation-operation failures stop rather than invoking model repair. Runtime repair feedback is control information, not an optional prompt variable or a reason to reattach omitted evidence.
semantics.source_filter: get_objects accepts one complete originating Source Connection key (tenant_code, system_code, connection_code). Resolve registered ingestion Object mappings before intersecting with scoped physical Objects. Preserve returned physical keys and deduplicate matches by those keys.
semantics.physical_keys: get_object_details uses complete keys returned by get_objects: GDS keys for Bronze Objects, Source keys for scoped Source Objects. No database IDs or temporary aliases.
semantics.output_shape: All six readers return the shared page envelope. Reassembling complete entries and marked Object-group slices recovers the selected variable value; paging fields are not added to prompt variable or stored record schemas.
semantics.limits: Use the accepted paging contract and existing response/cumulative/execution limits. Never silently truncate or split atomic evidence records; an indivisible oversized record is an explicit error.
semantics.errors: Malformed, partial, unknown or out-of-scope keys, unavailable tools, and exhausted budgets are errors, not successful empty evidence. No error triggers an unfiltered fallback.
semantics.analysis_shape_changes: Analysis gds_context is a list of the same five-field placement dictionaries; enrichment retains its dictionary/null shape. Other variable structures remain unchanged.
semantics.delivery: Accepted defaults: One-shot embeds all seven workflow variables. Tool-assisted embeds ingestion_mapping and selects six readers for Source context, GDS context, Objects, Object details, Object relationships, and Modeling Assertions. Template authors can change variable/tool selection. Ingestion mapping has no tool; omitted evidence is never appended automatically.
semantics.source_connection_identity: The user requires the full Source Connection natural key. Connection code is unique within System and Tenant, not globally (database/02_core.sql, ux_connection_system_tenant_code_ci). No bare-code shortcut or optional qualifier format.
semantics.ingestion_mapping_delivery: Accepted: ingestion_mapping remains an optional prompt variable. No ingestion-mapping tool will be added.
semantics.relationship_grouping: Accepted: object_relationship_context replaces the flat applied_relationships variable. One physical Object group has incoming_relationships and outgoing_relationships arrays of the existing 17-field relationship records. Direction is derived; storage and authored output remain flat. Empty groups are retained; duplicate directional views do not create new relationship identities.

relationship_quality_review.preferred_view: Physical Object groups with incoming and outgoing relationship lists, shared by variable and reader.
relationship_quality_review.fields: Retain actual existing relationship endpoint/kind/confidence/basis/status/lock fields. No validation fields or database changes.
relationship_quality_review.lock_presentation: Keep analysis_result_is_locked on each record; do not create four directional lock buckets. Locks govern mutability, not correctness.
relationship_quality_review.discovery: Retain global scoped Object inventory and eligible Attribute evidence; do not discover candidates only by traversing known relationships.
relationship_quality_review.tradeoff: Whole-scope groups repeat each relationship under both endpoint Objects. Focused reads limit exposure but do not eliminate the duplication when all groups are included.
relationship_quality_review.evidence_status: Expected clarity benefit is a design judgment. No comparative model evaluation has been run.

response_fields.items: Complete variable entries, or explicitly unfinished Object-group slices, in stable frozen order.
response_fields.next_cursor: Opaque continuation for this same tool/run/selection, or null when exhausted.
response_fields.is_complete: True exactly when next_cursor is null. Marks completion of the selected result across pages, not completeness of an isolated intermediate page.
response_fields.incomplete_object_key: Physical key of the last Object group when its nested lists continue; otherwise null. Only Object details and Object relationships may set it.

paging_contract.first_call: Use the accepted optional selection filters with cursor omitted/null. Existing all-scope defaults apply. No model-supplied page-size knob; the server uses frozen configured record and serialized-response byte caps.
paging_contract.continuation: Call the same tool with only cursor=next_cursor. The backend restores the original normalized filters and frozen position. Default-valued filter fields are harmless; any nondefault filter alongside cursor is an error. To change selection, start a new call with cursor=null.
paging_contract.cursor_binding: Bind cursors to the authorized frozen run, tool, normalized selection, and immutable paging position. Reject foreign/expired/invalid cursors. Repeating a cursor reproduces the same page; do not append a repeated page twice. A cursor is continuation metadata, not an Object/Attribute/assertion ID.
paging_contract.flat_records: Source entries, GDS entries, Object inventory entries, and assertion records are emitted whole. Ordinary pages append items in order; no field-level truncation.
paging_contract.nested_order: Process one Object group at a time. Details traverse Attributes in frozen order; relationships traverse incoming records then outgoing records in frozen order. At most the final group in a page can be unfinished, and the next page resumes that same key before later Objects.
paging_contract.detail_slices: A detail slice retains the complete physical Object key and complete Attribute/Profile records. selected_attribute_names contains the original selected names among that slice's Attributes. Append attributes and selected names across the same Object key to recover the original variable group.
paging_contract.relationship_slices: Retain the complete physical Object key. Append incoming_relationships and outgoing_relationships separately across slices. Each relationship record stays whole with the existing 17 fields. An empty list in an unfinished group may mean its records are still to come.
paging_contract.completion: incomplete_object_key identifies the only group requiring more slices after this page. If it is null, groups present on this page are complete when combined with previously read slices, although next_cursor may point to later Objects. Do not finalize an unfinished group as complete or treat its empty lists as absence.
paging_contract.empty_selection: Return items=[], next_cursor=null, is_complete=true, incomplete_object_key=null for a complete empty result. An Object with no Attributes or relationships remains an explicit complete Object group with empty lists.
paging_contract.limits: Size the entire serialized response including metadata under existing configured result budgets. Also preserve existing total-context, record-count, cumulative-result, and execution limits. Each nonfinal successful page makes progress. No silent truncation, omitted records, or unlimited-budget assumption.
paging_contract.oversized_atomic_record: Never split descriptions, basis text, assertion text/details, or an individual Attribute/Profile/relationship/assertion record into raw JSON fragments. If one indivisible record plus its necessary envelope cannot fit, return the existing explicit size-error class. Do not retry indefinitely or pretend the selection was complete.
paging_contract.errors: Errors use the existing tool-error path, not a successful empty page. Unknown keys, invalid cursors, changed continuation filters, and exhausted budgets never trigger unfiltered fallback.
paging_contract.variable_relationship: Prompt variables retain full list/group values without pagination metadata. Tool pages contain those same fields; only the result envelope and explicitly marked group slicing are added. Reassembled successful pages equal the corresponding selected variable value.

accepted_final_decisions.decision: get_modeling_assertions(assertion_keys=[]): omitted/empty returns all authorized active applicable records; supplied nominal keys filter them. Same approved seven-field output. No live document extraction or invented Object associations.

Keep existing response byte limits; deliver all matching records across explicit pages rather than silently truncate or rely only on size errors. Page continuation must clearly mark incomplete results; a single large Object may require continuation of its Attribute/relationship lists. Exact page envelope remains pending.

One-shot embeds all seven variables. Tool-assisted embeds ingestion_mapping and retrieves the other six through selected dedicated readers. Authors can change variable/tool selection. Review complete final prompt pairs and one example per mode afterward.
